The '''Republic Reserve Administration''' was a financial agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its development was overseen by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] who was, in reality, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
